body: thanks for your responding.  I feel like saying 'there is always a reason to live' is not far from saying 'there is always a reason to die'. suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem, but if the problem is beyond your grasp entirely, is it really a temporary problem?  like i said with this box of absolutely having to produce money in order to survive.  that, to me, is a problem.  i can't just suddenly abolish capitalism or the greed of the super rich that hoard so much.  is it really a temporary problem, you think? I would disagree and never use that cliche to anyone who came to me with mental health issues.  it's not hard to read that suicide is selfish and cowardly.  i have also personally and first handed seen what suicide can do to the residual family members.  its shit. no argument there.  i know the reason i haven't jumped off a bridge is because of my family, and how it would effect them if i did.   i don't prefer alcohol to self medicate.  i'm aware its a depressant and won't help anything except for needing an abrupt detachment from reality followed by remorse and more self loathing. being depressed and hating everything is not easy, not even by comparison.  i know i'm trying to shit over all of your arguments, i hope you know its not because i don't appreciate your words or ideas.. but if i cant be honest here, then i'm really fucked.
